title: Pathogen-Oriented Low-cost Assembly & Re-sequencing for SARS-CoV-2 Diagnosis
author: Per A. Adastra

steps.title: Prepare Viral RNA Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers for RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Add beta-mercaptoethanol to the Viral RNA Buffer to a final dilution of 0.5% volume (e.g., 500 µL per 100 ml).
Add 192 mL of 100% ethanol (or 204 mL of 95% ethanol) to the 48 mL Viral Wash Buffer concentrate.

steps.title: Extract Viral RNA
steps.instruction: Perform RNA extraction using Zymo-Spin™ I-96 plates.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 96 patient samples into each well of the Zymo-Spin™ I-96 plate; keep on ice.
Add 400 µL of Viral RNA Buffer to each sample well and mix by pipetting.
Mount the Zymo-Spin™ I-96 plate on a Collection Plate and centrifuge at 3000 x g to 5000 x g for 00:05:00; discard flow-through.
Add 500 µL Viral Wash Buffer to each well, centrifuge at 3000 x g to 5000 x g for 00:05:00, and discard flow-through. Repeat this wash step.
Add 500 µL ethanol (95-100%) to each well and centrifuge at 3000 x g to 5000 x g for 00:05:00.
Mount a new 96-well plate between the Zymo-Spin™ I-96 plate and an empty Collection Plate.
Add 15 µL DNase/RNase-Free Water directly to the column matrix and centrifuge at 3000 x g to 5000 x g for 00:05:00 to elute RNA into the middle plate.

steps.title: Prepare cDNA
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA from the eluted RNA extract.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a mastermix of dNTPs and Random Hexamers for 96 samples; add 1 µL of mastermix to each well of a 96-well plate.
Add 5.5 µL of RNA extract (from extraction step) to each well.
Set-up and run the cDNA preparation program on a thermal cycler to incubate the reaction.
Prepare a second mastermix for 96 samples; add 3.5 µL of this mastermix to each well containing the annealed template RNA.
Set-up and run the second cDNA preparation program on a thermal cycler.

steps.title: Perform Multiplex PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify target regions using pool-based PCR.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Pool #1 and Pool #2 master mixes for 96 samples; aliquot 22.5 µL of the corresponding mix into two 96-well plates labeled Pool #1 and Pool #2.
Add 2.5 µL of cDNA from each biological sample to both Pool #1 and Pool #2 plates.
Set-up and run the Multiplex PCR program on a thermal cycler.

steps.title: Post-PCR Clean-up
steps.instruction: Purify PCR products using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume (1:1) of sparQ PureMag beads (e.g., 50 µL beads to 50 µL reaction) to each well in Pool #1 and Pool #2 plates; mix gently and pulse centrifuge.
Incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.
Place plates on Agencourt SPRIPlate Super Magnet Plate (A32782) for 00:02:00 or until supernatant is clear; carefully remove supernatant.
Add 200 µL of room temperature 80% ethanol to the side of the well opposite the pellet; let sit for 00:00:30.
Carefully remove ethanol, wait 00:00:10, and remove any remaining ethanol.
Add 20 µL of 10 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8.0), mix by pipetting, and incubate for 00:02:00 at 37 °C.
Place plates on the magnet plate for 00:02:00 until pelleted.
Transfer supernatant from each biological sample in the two plates (Pool #1 and Pool #2) and combine into a single well per sample in a new 96-well plate.

steps.title: Quantify DNA Concentration
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using Qubit® High Sensitivity DNA kit.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a working solution by diluting Qubit® dsDNA HS Reagent 1:200 in Qubit® dsDNA HS Buffer (e.g., 199 µL buffer and 1 µL dye per sample).
Prepare standard tubes: add 190 µL working solution and 10 µL standard to each; vortex.
Prepare sample tubes: add 199 µL working solution and 1 µL of sample to 0.5-mL tubes; vortex.
Incubate all tubes at room temperature for 00:02:00.
Using Qubit® 3.0 Fluorometer (dsDNA High Sensitivity mode), read Standard #1 and Standard #2.
Quantify all samples using a 1 µL sample volume setting.

steps.title: Nextera Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Tagment and amplify DNA to create libraries.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a mastermix of Tagment mix and Tagment Buffer for 96 samples; aliquot 6 µL into a new 96-well plate and add 4 µL of 1ng Amplicon DNA.
Incubate at 55 °C for 00:05:00, then lower to 10 °C.
Immediately add 2.5 µL of Neutralizing Tagment Buffer at 10 °C and mix by pipetting.
Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00 and centrifuge at 280 x g for 00:01:00.
Prepare a Nextera PCR Master Mix with Index Primers 1 and 2 for 96 samples; aliquot 12.5 µL into a new 96-well plate and add 12.5 µL of tagmented amplicon DNA.
Set-up and run the Nextera library preparation program on a thermal cycler.

steps.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a double-round bead cleanup of the final library.

substeps.instruction: Bring sample volume in each well to 50 µL with nuclease-free water.
Incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.
Place on Agencourt SPRIPlate Super Magnet Plate for 00:02:00; remove clear supernatant.
Add a 1:1.8 ratio of sparQ PureMag beads (e.g., 90 µL beads to 50 µL reaction) and mix gently.
While on magnetic plate, add 200 µL of room temperature 80% ethanol to the side opposite the pellet; let sit for 00:00:30.
Remove ethanol, wait 00:00:10, and remove remaining ethanol.
Add 100 µL of 10 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8.0), vortex, pulse centrifuge, and incubate for 00:02:00 at 37 °C.
Add an equal volume (1:1) of sparQ PureMag beads (e.g., 100 µL beads to 100 µL reaction) and mix gently.
Incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.
Separate beads on Agencourt SPRIPlate Super Magnet Plate for 00:02:00; remove clear supernatant.
While on magnetic plate, add 200 µL of room temperature 80% ethanol to the side opposite the pellet; let sit for 00:00:30.
Remove ethanol, wait 00:00:10, and remove remaining ethanol.
Add 20 µL of 10 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8.0), mix by pipetting, and incubate for 00:02:00 at 37 °C.
Place on Agencourt SPRIPlate Super Magnet Plate for 00:02:00; transfer the 20 µL final library to a new plate.

steps.title: Library Normalization
steps.instruction: Normalize library concentrations using LNA reagents.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 10 µL supernatant from each well of the PCR plate to a new midi plate.
Prepare LN master mix: combine 23 µL LNA1 and 4 µL LNA2 (multiplied by number of samples); mix by pipetting.
Transfer 22.5 µL LN master mix to each sample well.
Seal plate and shake at 1800 rpm for 00:30:00.
Place on magnetic stand for ~2 minutes until clear; discard supernatant.
Wash twice: add 22.5 µL LNW1, shake at 1800 rpm for 00:05:00, separate on magnet for ~2 minutes, and discard supernatant.
Add 15 µL 0.1 N NaOH to each well and shake at 1800 rpm for 00:05:00.
Add 15 µL LNS1 to each well of a new 96-well PCR plate labeled SGP.
If samples in midi plate are not resuspended, shake at 1800 rpm for 00:05:00.
Place on magnet rack and transfer 15 µL supernatant from midi plate to SGP plate.
Seal the SGP plate and centrifuge at 1000 x g for 00:01:00.

steps.title: Load NextSeq 550 Sequencer
steps.instruction: Prepare reagents and load the normalized library onto the sequencer.

substeps.instruction: Thaw a "Mid-Output Kit" reagent cartridge in a room temperature water bath for 01:00:00.
After 00:30:00 of cartridge thawing, warm a "Mid-Output Kit" flow cell at room temperature for 00:30:00.
Dry the thawed cartridge, invert to mix reagents (ensure positions 29-32 are thawed), and tap to remove bubbles.
Clean the flow cell with a 70% ethanol wipe and dry.
Inspect flow cell ports, gaskets, white plastic posts, retention clips, and spring clips.
Thaw Hybridization Buffer (HT1) at room temperature, then place on ice.
Combine aliquots from each library pool in a 1.5ml tube to a total volume of 5 µL.
Add 995 µL ice-cold HT1, vortex briefly, and centrifuge at 300 x g for 00:01:00.
Prepare hybridization mix: combine 1203 µL ice-cold HT1 and 97 µL diluted library (final concentration 1.5 pM); invert, pulse centrifuge, and keep on ice.
Alternatively, transfer 750 µL of diluted library to a tube, add 750 µL ice-cold HT1, vortex, centrifuge at 300 x g for 00:01:00, incubate at 98 °C for 00:02:00, then cool on ice for 00:05:00.
Poke a hole in the foil seal of position 10 ("Load Library Here") of the reagent cartridge using a P1000 tip.
Add the entire 1.3ml of the 1.5 pM library dilution into reservoir 10.
Load the reagent cartridge, flow cell, and buffer pack onto the NextSeq 500.
